EX-99.2 3 adbeex992q124.htm EX-99.2 Document Exhibit 99.2 Investor Relations Contact Jonathan Vaas Adobe ir@adobe.com Public Relations Contact Ashley Levine Adobe adobepr@adobe.com FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Adobe Announces New $25 Billion Stock Repurchase Program SAN JOSE, Calif. – March 14, 2024 – Adobe (Nasdaq:ADBE) announced that its board of directors has approved a new stock repurchase authorization, granting the company authority to repurchase up to $25 billion in common stock through March 14, 2028.
